title: 3 Questions

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Where did SenexCTW go?
Not sure where it went. Probably removed by a map dev or something.

Where did Walls go?
Walls was removed some time ago due to lack of players and the server was shut down. There was talk of it possibly returning, not sure if any further development progress has happened since then.

When will Destroy01 be added back?
As soon as our developer can get on and bring the server up.
